rule: quality gate + price-action entry, hold while strong (stop -25%)
note: Entry timing is point-in-time (bars[:t] only). Statements are today's - no point-in-time fundamentals - so business quality is held fixed and the exit is a hard stop rather than fundamental deterioration. Buy-and-hold is measured on the same quality-gated names over the same window, so the comparison is like for like.
